messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Hi! We saw your profile on a jobs page. Work-from-home data entry — 4,000 PKR daily, paid every night.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Sounds good, what is the catch?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: No catch. You just pay a one-time advance deposit of 3,000 for your software license and portal login.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Can the company deduct it from my first salary instead?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Company policy says no advance without deposit. Only 2 slots left today — decide fast.
